name: portal_id
label: HubSpot portal ID
help_text: Weld Australia staging portal is 441838610. Used by the Forms API submission URL.

name: profile_update_form
label: Profile update form
help_text: Select the Weld HubSpot form whose fields map to the editable contact properties below. Submitted via Forms API to update the logged-in contact. Create this form in HubSpot with fields named: firstname, lastname, email, phone, mobilephone, address, city, state, zip, jobtitle, date_of_birth, job_function.

name: company_link_property
label: Member company ID property
help_text: Issue 30. Leave EMPTY to hide the 'Connect your company' field entirely. To switch it on, enter the internal name of the contact property that stores the member company ID (agree it with Ollie first) AND add a field with that exact name to the profile update form above. The form submits every named input to the Forms API, so a property that is not on the form makes HubSpot reject the whole submission and no profile change saves at all - that is why this is off until it is configured on both sides.

name: company_link_help
label: Member company ID help text
default: Work for a Weld Australia member company? Enter its member company ID to have member pricing applied to your training and event bookings.

name: show_preferences_link
label: Show email preferences link
help_text: Turn on to show the Communications preferences card. Keep off until /email-subscriptions/ is confirmed live — members can still manage preferences via the link in any marketing email.

name: preferences_link
label: Email preferences page
help_text: Choose the published Subscription Preferences page. Defaults to /email-subscriptions/, which only resolves once the Subscription Preferences Page is assigned + published in HubSpot Settings -> Website -> Pages -> System pages. Until then this link 404s.

name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.
